about: What the 참가자 게시판 refuses and accepts. One list, read by both copies of the rules: scripts/check-grants.mjs posts each case to the trigger (supabase/migrations), and tests/unit/board-filter.test.mjs gives each to the browser's copy (src/state/useBoard.js). `reason` is what the refusal is about: link, contact, characters (too few visible ones), or blocked (a word on src/boardBlockedTerms.js, read through foldBoardText).
